title: Document dynamic setSeverity references
body:
## Summary
- Add a "Dynamic severity" subsection to `asserts.md` describing the new `setSeverity: <path>.stdout` form, the `0..5` coercion rules, and the silent-null-plus-warning behaviour on invalid refs.

Depends on the feature landing in `satorici/playbook-validator` + `satorici/analyze`.

## Test plan
- [ ] `npm run docs:build` renders the new section
- [ ] Reviewer confirms the example matches the implemented behaviour
